dataset: IEEE-CIS public model-ready derivative / Vesta-origin data
primary_question: Among already high-confidence financial decisions, does a current-stage maturity diagnostic predict later enriched-action reversal better than ordinary confidence and a supervised posterior-trajectory baseline?

bootstrap.fallback: transaction only if fewer than 20 usable card clusters

success_rule: For the same pre-terminal stage and same primary endpoint, the 95% paired bootstrap CI for maturity-minus-confidence and maturity-minus-trajectory must both have lower bound > 0.
failure_rule: If the success rule is not met on the sealed test block, do not retune on test, do not add a new controller, and remove the claim of real-data superiority.
leakage_controls: terminal action is an outcome label, never a test-time maturity feature
fit stage fraud models on train only
fit maturity and trajectory reversal models on validation only
